Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved Watchlists Not Persisting  **No code changes made — this is a plan only, per the high-impact/no-edit instruction.**  ### What's actually happening  I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → DB schema.  - **Backend is correct.** `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` derives `user_id` from the session (via `X-User-Id` set by the auth check), and every route (list, create, read, update, delete, add/remove item) filters or writes against that `user_id`.
